title: Linear Probes Transfer from Base to Distilled Language Models despite Rotation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear probes, classifiers that read a language model's internal activations, are widely used to detect harmful requests. They are cheap to train and run, and an auditor who has trained one would like to reuse it when the model is replaced by a successor rather than retrain it for every release. We test how well probes can be reused. For four base models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B) we train a probe on the base model with the XSTest prompt set and apply it, unchanged, to two successors of that base: the DeepSeek-R1 distilled reasoning model and the developer's instruction-tuned chat model. We find that the successors rotate the direction separating unsafe from safe prompts by 17$^\circ$ to 35$^\circ$, yet on XSTest the transferred probe's AUC changes by only $-0.011$ to $+0.027$, and on an independent OR-Bench evaluation, never used for training, by $-0.015$ to $+0.053$. translated_title: 线性探针在方向旋转的情况下仍能从基础语言模型迁移到蒸馏语言模型
translated_abstract: 线性探针是一种读取语言模型内部激活的分类器，被广泛用于检测有害请求。它训练和运行成本低廉，已经训练过探针的审计人员希望在模型被后继版本替换时能复用它，而不是每次发布都重新训练。我们测试了探针的复用效果。对于四个基础模型，我们在基础模型上使用XSTest提示集训练一个探针，然后不加修改地将其应用于该基础模型的两个后继版本：DeepSeek-R1蒸馏推理模型和开发者发布的指令微调聊天模型。我们发现，后继模型将区分不安全提示与安全提示的方向旋转了17°到35°，但在XSTest上，迁移后的探针AUC变化仅为-0.011到+0.027；在从未用于训练的独立OR-Bench评估上，变化为-0.015到+0.053。在安全提示刻意（设计以模仿有害请求的）XSTest上……
tldr: 研究发现，尽管蒸馏推理模型和指令微调模型会使线性探针所依赖的安全/不安全提示分离方向旋转17°到35°，但在基础模型上训练的有害请求检测探针无需任何修改即可有效迁移到这些后继模型上，AUC变化极小。
en_tdlr: Linear probes trained on base language models to detect harmful requests transfer effectively—without any modification—to distilled reasoning and instruction-tuned successor models, despite a 17° to 35° rotation of the separating direction, with only minimal changes in AUC.
